title: A worker the manager dispatched is shown the manager's own claim of its item as an overlap and told to ask the operator
goal: SP-xo45jvbj review G1 (ST-x6mvfnmv): the coord hook posts an intent for the item at the manager's backlog.py claim (coord_hook.py PreToolUse Bash), and the headless worker dispatched on work/<id> then sees that intent at its SessionStart with the footer 'ask the operator whether to wait, join or proceed', on every item of the normal dispatch flow, with no operator in a claude -p worker. A worker's SessionStart on work/<id> shows no overlap for the claim intent the dispatching session posted for that same item, while another session's intent for the item still shows.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite'))
E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(D,n);s.run(['git','init','-q','-b',b,r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True);return r
def hook(cwd,**p):
    p.setdefault('cwd',cwd);return s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(p),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60).stdout
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300)
r=repo('r','work/ST-abcd1234')
hook(D,hook_event_name='PreToolUse',session_id='repro-manager',tool_name='Bash',tool_input={'command':'python3 _tools/backlog.py claim ST-abcd1234 --by m --commit'})
c('post','--kind','intent','--field','session=repro-other','--field','item=ST-abcd1234')
out=hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionStart',session_id='repro-worker',source='startup')
hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-worker',reason='exit');hook(D,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-manager',reason='exit')
res=dict(manager_claim_hidden='repro-manager' not in out,other_still_shown='repro-other' in out)
print(res,repr(out[:300]));sys.exit(0 if all(res.values()) else 1)
